title: Virtual Compute: snapshot allocation — metered slices
content:
## Applicable basis

Virtual Compute snapshot allocation — Sum posted snapshot supplemental meter quantities for the exact export reference, selected holding and period; these metered GB-month slices are disjoint parts of the same exported resource scope. Cancelled snapshot quantities remain separately visible for reconciliation and are excluded from the metered subtotal.
